brief: Holds a list that was provided as text, such as '[ 1, 2, "A" ]', to tell values from variable names; unfinished today.
detail: The idea, from the comment in its file: a list written as text can hold values (1, "A", [ 5, "V" ]) or variable names (n1, aList1), and a search must be able to look for a value wherever it is hosted or for a variable whatever its value. Today the class does not deliver it: Items answers an empty list for every text, ContainsOnlyValues and IsListOfValues raise error R12, and the three other tests are empty stubs answering an empty text. To evaluate a list written as text use stzListInString, which turns it into a real list.
